mapper.update: UPDATE work_order SET insurance_company=#{row.insuranceCompany},claim_no=#{row.claimNo},claim_reported_at=#{row.claimReportedAt}, owner_name=#{row.ownerName},owner_phone=#{row.ownerPhone},policy_no=#{row.policyNo},vehicle_brand=#{row.vehicleBrand}, vehicle_model=#{row.vehicleModel},vehicle_vin=#{row.vehicleVin},vehicle_plate=#{row.vehiclePlate}, vehicle_other_identifier=#{row.vehicleOtherIdentifier},accident_at=#{row.accidentAt},accident_region_id=#{row.accidentRegionId}, accident_address=#{row.accidentAddress},accident_description=#{row.accidentDescription},updated_by=#{actorId},updated_at=#{now},version=version+1 WHERE id=#{row.id} AND status='DRAFT' AND version=#{row.version}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM work_order WHERE id=#{id} AND status='DRAFT' AND version=#{version}
mapper.select: SELECT * FROM work_order WHERE id=#{id}
SELECT * FROM work_order WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE

where.if: AND (lower(COALESCE(w.business_no,'')) LIKE lower('%'||#{query}||'%') OR lower(COALESCE(w.claim_no,'')) LIKE lower('%'||#{query}||'%') OR COALESCE(w.owner_phone,'') LIKE '%'||#{query}||'%')

mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM work_order w
SELECT w.* FROM work_order w ORDER BY w.updated_at DESC,w.id DESC LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT id FROM work_order_config WHERE id=1 FOR UPDATE
SELECT possible_duplicate_days FROM work_order_config WHERE id=1

SELECT business_no FROM work_order WHERE status<>'DRAFT' AND lower(insurance_company)=lower(#{insuranceCompany}) AND lower(claim_no)=lower(#{claimNo}) AND id<>#{excludeId} ORDER BY created_at,id LIMIT 1
mapper.sql: ((#{vin,jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NOT NULL AND w.vehicle_vin=#{vin,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) OR (#{plate,jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NOT NULL AND w.vehicle_plate=#{plate,jdbcType=VARCHAR}) OR (#{otherIdentifier,jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NOT NULL AND w.vehicle_other_identifier=#{otherIdentifier,jdbcType=VARCHAR}))
mapper.select: SELECT DISTINCT w.business_no FROM work_order w WHERE w.id<>#{id} AND w.status<>'DRAFT' AND ( (#{vin,jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NOT NULL AND w.vehicle_vin=#{vin,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND w.accident_at BETWEEN CAST(#{accidentAt} AS timestamptz) - make_interval(days => #{days}) AND CAST(#{accidentAt} AS timestamptz) + make_interval(days => #{days})) OR (w.owner_phone=#{phone,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND AND w.accident_at BETWEEN CAST(#{accidentAt} AS timestamptz) - make_interval(days => #{days}) AND CAST(#{accidentAt} AS timestamptz) + make_interval(days => #{days})) OR (#{policyNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NOT NULL AND w.policy_no=#{policyNo,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND ) ) ORDER BY w.business_no LIMIT 10

SELECT DISTINCT w.business_no FROM work_order w WHERE w.id<>#{id} AND w.status<>'DRAFT' AND w.owner_phone=#{phone,jdbcType=VARCHAR} AND w.shop_id=#{shopId} AND w.accident_at BETWEEN CAST(#{accidentAt} AS timestamptz) - make_interval(days => #{days}) AND CAST(#{accidentAt} AS timestamptz) + make_interval(days => #{days}) ORDER BY w.business_no LIMIT 10
INSERT INTO work_order_number_counter(business_date,last_value) VALUES(#{date},1) ON CONFLICT(business_date) DO UPDATE SET last_value=work_order_number_counter.last_value+1 RETURNING last_value
mapper.update: UPDATE work_order SET insurance_company=#{insuranceCompany},claim_no=#{claimNo},vehicle_vin=#{vin},vehicle_plate=#{plate}, vehicle_other_identifier=#{otherIdentifier},updated_by=#{actorId},updated_at=#{now},version=version+1 WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND status NOT IN ('DRAFT','CANCELLED','CLOSED')
mapper.select: SELECT op.user_id FROM owner_profile op JOIN app_user u ON u.id=op.user_id AND u.enabled JOIN user_role ur ON ur.user_id=u.id JOIN app_role r ON r.id=ur.role_id AND r.code='OWNER' WHERE op.contact_phone=#{phone} ORDER BY op.user_id LIMIT 2
SELECT count(*) FROM region WHERE id=#{id} AND enabled
SELECT count(*) FROM repair_shop s JOIN shop_service_region ssr ON ssr.shop_id=s.id WHERE s.id=#{shopId} AND s.enabled AND ssr.region_id=#{regionId}
SELECT count(DISTINCT s.id) FROM repair_shop s JOIN shop_service_region ssr ON ssr.shop_id=s.id WHERE s.enabled AND ssr.region_id=#{regionId}

SELECT DISTINCT s.id,s.code,s.name,s.address FROM repair_shop s JOIN shop_service_region ssr ON ssr.shop_id=s.id WHERE s.enabled AND ssr.region_id=#{regionId} ORDER BY s.name,s.id LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT COALESCE(max(assignment_version),0)+1 FROM work_order_assignment WHERE work_order_id=#{workOrderId}
SELECT * FROM work_order_assignment WHERE work_order_id=#{workOrderId} AND status IN ('PENDING','ACCEPTED') ORDER BY assignment_version DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT * FROM work_order_assignment WHERE work_order_id=#{workOrderId} AND assignment_version=#{version}
mapper.update: UPDATE work_order_assignment SET status='ACCEPTED',responded_by=#{actorId},responded_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PENDING'
UPDATE work_order_assignment SET status='REJECTED',reason=#{reason},responded_by=#{actorId},responded_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND status='PENDING'
UPDATE work_order_assignment SET status='CANCELLED',reason=#{reason},cancelled_by=#{actorId},cancelled_at=#{now} WHERE id=#{id} AND status IN ('PENDING','ACCEPTED')
mapper.select: SELECT count(*) FROM work_order_status_history WHERE work_order_id=#{workOrderId}

SELECT id,from_status,to_status,action,reason,actor_id,actor_roles,assignment_version,occurred_at FROM work_order_status_history WHERE work_order_id=#{workOrderId} ORDER BY occurred_at,id LIMIT #{size} OFFSET #{offset}
SELECT work_order_id,assignment_version,response_json FROM work_order_command WHERE actor_id=#{actorId} AND operation=#{operation} AND idempotency_key=#{key}
mapper.update: UPDATE work_order_command SET response_json=#{responseJson},completed_at=CURRENT_TIMESTAMP WHERE actor_id=#{actorId} AND operation=#{operation} AND idempotency_key=#{key} AND response_json IS NULL
